title: Маршрут на мелководье
description:
FeaturesHunting and Mining for Survival Essentials
Gather vital resources for survival through hunting and mining.

Explore a Beautiful and Vast Open World and Ocean
Venture into an expansive open world and explore the serene yet mysterious open ocean.

Diverse Outfits and Hairstyles for Beautiful Girls
Customize characters with a wide range of outfits and hairstyles.

Stroll Through Lush Forests and Dive Into Stunning Yet Perilous Oceans
Discover surprises and unexpected treasures in every corner of this breathtaking world.

Comprehensive Blueprint Crafting System
Design and build with a fully-featured blueprint system.

Mysterious Treasures
Unearth hidden treasures scattered across the world.

Rich Crafting Systems with Multiple Workbenches
Includes campfires, looms, dew collectors, chemical workbenches, and more to enhance your survival experience.

Diverse Biome Systems
Encounter a variety of marine and terrestrial ecosystems, making your island survival less lonely.

Challenging Survival Mechanics
Face hunger, thirst, illness, injuries, and other challenges. Craft advanced survival tools to counter these negative states. Beware of special threats like fishmen and wolves that may attack your island, and arm yourself for protection.

Farming System
Collect seeds from edible fruits and vegetables on the island to create your own farming zone. Plant, harvest, and establish a sustainable food and water supply.

Building System
Use a survival construction guide to build your home, such as a seaside villa overlooking the ocean.
All decorations and furnishings are fully customizable to suit your unique style.
description_short: Find the secret treasure and explore the secrets of this mysterious island,and there are a large number of enemies on the island.You need to use your courage and scientific knowledge to survive on this island,And find a way to leave this island!
